claim: Global warming: P(value in 2100 above 1.5 °C) = 0.99 [derived]
source: Climate Action Tracker, November 2026, current policies: normal curve fitted to the 16th and 50th percentiles

claim: Heat beyond the human range: P(value in 2100 above 5 %) = 0.99 [derived]
source: Lenton et al. 2023, Nature Sustainability: 5% at 1.5 °C, with the warming card's 99% above 1.5 °C

claim: More frequent extreme weather today: 4.8 times (2010)
source: IPCC AR6 WGI, Figure SPM.6: at 1 °C, the 2001–2020 average

claim: Sea-level rise: P(value in 2100 above 44 cm) = 0.83 [published]
source: IPCC AR6, intermediate emissions (SSP2-4.5): bottom of the likely range

claim: Greenland and Antarctic ice sheets today: 2 m (2025)
source: IPCC AR6: about 2 to 3 m over 2,000 years if warming stays at 1.5 °C; 2025 was 1.43 °C (WMO)

claim: Heat stored in the ocean today: 480 ZJ (2025)
source: IPCC AR6: 396 ZJ over 1971–2018, plus about 12.6 ZJ a year since then (WMO 2025)

claim: Planetary boundaries crossed today: 7 of 9 (2026)
source: Planetary Health Check 2026, Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research

claim: Asteroid or comet impact: P(value in 2100 above 50 m) = 0.037 [derived]
source: National Research Council, Defending Planet Earth, 2010: one impact per 2,000 years

claim: Asteroid or comet impact: 10000–20000 m means level 5 (Mass extinction, as for the dinosaurs 66 million years ago) [published]
source: National Research Council, Defending Planet Earth, 2010, table 2.1 and fatality model

claim: Solar storm today: 907 nT (May 1921 storm)
source: Love, Hayakawa & Cliver 2019 (USGS)

claim: Deadliest war before 2100: P(value in 2100 above 10 % of humanity) = 0.04 [derived]
source: Forecasting Research Institute, XPT 2022: superforecasters’ median for nuclear weapons killing over 10% of humanity within five years, by 2100 (nuclear experts: 8%). Nuclear only, so a floor

claim: State-based armed conflicts today: 65 conflicts (2025)
source: Uppsala Conflict Data Program (UCDP), June 2026

claim: Deadliest biological attack: P(value in 2100 above 1 % of humanity) = 0.04 [derived]
source: XPT superforecasters, 2022 (Forecasting Research Institute): a genetically engineered pathogen, released on purpose or by accident, killing over 1% of humanity within five years, by 2100 (biorisk experts: 10.25%). A stand-in for deliberate use

claim: Civil war and state breakdown today: 31 % of humanity (Taiping war, China)

claim: Political polarisation today: -0.1 score (2025)

claim: Pandemics today: 2.7 % (1918 flu (modern record))

claim: Pandemics: 1–10 % means level 2 (1918 flu scale: 100 million to a billion dead within a few years) [derived]

claim: Human-caused pandemics: P(value in 2100 above 99.9999 %) = 0.0001 [published]
source: XPT superforecasters, 2022 (Forecasting Research Institute): extinction by an engineered pathogen, meaning fewer than 5,000 survivors

claim: Drug-resistant infections: 12–120 per 100,000 people means level 2 (1 to 10 deaths in 100 are due to resistance; care gets riskier) [derived]
